title: apply result
description: What a successful apply returns. exec and recipe return the same fields plus their own. A rejected batch returns error.schema.json instead.

batch.description: This batch's ID. Pass it to revert to undo exactly this batch.

ids.description: IDs Reflex generated or changed, keyed by op position, such as {"ops[2]": "note-1"}. Use these IDs from now on.

repaired.description: Mistakes Reflex fixed for you, one line each. The batch was applied with the fix.

lints.description: Problems with how the result looks, such as text covering a person's Ink. The batch was applied anyway.

look.description: Only when the call set look: true. The rendered crop follows this JSON as image 1.

bounds.description: [x, y, width, height] in the reading Agent's coordinates. x and y are the top-left corner.

coord.description: One coordinate in the reading Agent's own integer coordinate space for this Space. Its origin never moves (ADR-0007).

count.description: A non-negative integer in the shared safe range.

element_id.description: A short ID the Agent chose, such as 'n-auth'. IDs are scoped to the Agent that made them, so two Agents never collide. Reflex-made IDs (Ink, user imports, generated) use the same alphabet.

length.description: A width, height or gap in the same units as coord.

code.description: A stable code, such as overlaps_ink, overlaps, endpoint_unattached, text_overflow, off_canvas or low_contrast.

look_output.title: look result
look_output.description: Over MCP the rendered PNG follows this JSON as an image block. The CLI writes it to file.

bounds.description: The part of the Space the image covers, in your coordinates.

px.description: [width, height] of the image in pixels.

file.description: CLI only: where the PNG was written.

pending_sends.description: How many Sends wait in this Agent's Inbox. Every tool result carries it. Drain them with wait_for_user(timeout_s: 0).
